folds.heading: ### Core-foundation checkpoint uptake B265
folds.body:
Five complete [A1](gm/dispatch/core-foundations-2026-10-14/a1/CHECKPOINT.md), [A2](gm/dispatch/core-foundations-2026-10-14/a2/CHECKPOINT.md), [A3](gm/dispatch/core-foundations-2026-10-14/a3/CHECKPOINT.md), [A4](gm/dispatch/core-foundations-2026-10-14/a4/CHECKPOINT.md) and [A5](gm/dispatch/core-foundations-2026-10-14/a5/CHECKPOINT.md) checkpoints were read. Preserve them as historical, distinct lane receipts. A1 is docs-only; A2 pure tag-store work; A3 direct travel tests; A4 detached relationship view and source inventory; A5 determinism ratchets/headless probes. A checkpoint's COMPLETE is scoped to its lane, not integration or current runtime coverage. Main docs were unstaged in those receipts, and source commits lived on separate branches. None of those branches, clean-tree assertions, reservations or commit contents was revalidated here.

A2 retains unknown tag IDs under its explicitly recorded lane requirement, not a global change to all registries. A4's42literal lines in32files are declarations, not runtime writers. Its detached view does not infer reverse relationships, merge incompatible sources, add consent or reveal hidden dimensions. Use actual source-qualified relationship readers when selected. A3’s124focused tests are a subset of its758full count; A4’s15focused are included in34scoped; A2’s21includes17new and4existing. A5’s9contains6pass+3TODO and643contains640pass+3TODO. These suites ran at different lane inputs; no summation or all-green current build is inferred. A5 read but did not merge the seeded-stream branch, and its48boundary replay is not a native gameplay/save journey.

Useful A1 consolidation, A2 unknown preservation, A3 direct travel contracts, A4 relationship-source correction and A5 unseeded-route residue remain accessible in their owners. Their linked PLAN/REPORT/AUDIT bodies were not read by proxy; the inventoried A1 PLAN and A4 AUDIT still need their own full-content review. No actor/tag migration, current integration, native browser/save proof, worker dispatch or new test run follows from this uptake. Current AD36/AD42/AD51 and actual one-writer ownership govern a later selected task.
